panel.pick: Pick a branch, tag or commit, then Compare.
picker.name: Branches, tags and recent commits
picker.typed: Nothing matches “%1”. Press Enter to compare with it as typed.
summary.title: Compared with %1
summary.name: Marks by kind
summary.capped: Only the first %1 of %2 marks are shown: HikariSub marks at most %1 Lines.
list.name: Changed Lines
problem.no_git.title: Git isn’t available
problem.no_git.body: HikariSub couldn’t run git. Install Git (Git for Windows on Windows), make sure it is on PATH, then choose Refresh.
problem.no_repository.title: Not in a git repository
problem.no_repository.body: %1 isn’t in a git repository, so there is nothing to compare it with.
problem.unsafe_repository.title: Git doesn’t trust this repository
problem.unsafe_repository.body: Another user owns %3. If you trust it, run this command, then choose Refresh:
problem.no_path.title: Save the file first
problem.no_path.body: This file was never saved, so it isn’t in a repository yet.
problem.no_file.title: %1 isn’t in %2
problem.no_file.body: It may have been added after %2, or renamed since. Pick another branch, tag or commit.
problem.no_ref.title: There is no %2
problem.no_ref.body: Git doesn’t know a branch, tag or commit by that name. Pick one from the list.
problem.not_ass.title: Only ASS files can be compared
problem.not_ass.body: %1 isn’t an ASS file. Marks need ASS Events to match Lines.
problem.not_ass_at_ref.title: %1 isn’t ASS in %2
problem.not_ass_at_ref.body: The file at %2 has no [Events] section, so its Lines can’t be matched. Pick another branch, tag or commit.
problem.timed_out.title: Git took too long
problem.timed_out.body: Git didn’t answer within 10 seconds. Choose Refresh to try again.
problem.too_large.title: The file is too large
problem.too_large.body: %1 at %2 is over 16 MB, more than HikariSub reads from git.
problem.not_text.title: The file isn’t text
problem.not_granted.title: Git access is off
problem.not_granted.body: This plugin can’t read git here.
problem.failed.title: Git couldn’t read the repository
